expected_authority: CTRL-WAVE0 / CTRL-CONVERGENCE; PR287 v4 execution-orchestration authority
intended_change: Ensure STD-EXTERNAL-CONFORMANCE or any equivalent public external-conformance activation cannot bypass an explicit licensing/publication-rights decision. Preserve internal IND-STD drafting before the decision. An acceptable implementation could require G-LICENSING-DISTRIBUTION-DECISION directly or introduce a narrower specification/vector/publication-rights gate adjudicated before external conformance.
rationale: External conformance can imply third-party implementation rights, public vector reuse, naming/certification claims, and redistribution expectations. The current v4 model gates IND-SDK behind the licensing decision but gates STD-EXTERNAL-CONFORMANCE only behind G4_STANDARD_DRAFT_READY.
invariants: Do not block internal standard/spec drafting solely because the project currently has no license.
Do not weaken existing technical gates.
Do not select a legal license or policy family inside the control plane.
Do not make passing public tests equivalent to trademark/certification authority.
Aliases must not weaken the new publication-rights guard.
tests: Validator proves STD-EXTERNAL-CONFORMANCE has an explicit path through the licensing/publication-rights decision.
IND-STD remains able to proceed when its technical dependencies are met even if the licensing decision is unresolved.
No new dependency cycle is introduced.
